entities.name: Abduction of Russian diplomats in Iraq
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: The 2006 abduction of Russian diplomats in Iraq took place on June 3, 2006, in Baghdad, Iraq when Iraqi insurgents ambushed a car belonging to the Russian Embassy. Vitaly Titov,, was killed in the attack and the other four people in the car – Fyodor Zaitsev, Rinat Agliuglin, Oleg Fedoseyev, and Anatoly Smirnov – were abducted.
